title: Room Block Checklist
subtitle: Capture group code, room types, cutoff, and pickup pace; confirm attrition review and housing handoff.
description: Room Block records group code, room types, cutoff, pickup pace, attrition review, and housing handoff. Room Block evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this room block stage-gated verification when staff must document group code and room types. Reconcile cutoff, pickup pace, attrition review, and housing handoff before the room block handoff. Use the group agreement reference, inventory grid, rate sheet, booking link, rooming list, pickup report, cutoff reminder, attrition review, and housing reconciliation. Ask the assigned room block reviewer to confirm group code against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Room Block starting details
sections.guidance: Define group code, room types and nightly inventory, rate, cutoff, pickup pace, rooming-list owner, attrition checkpoint, special routing, and housing handoff.

sections.title: Room Block checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current room block facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Room Block required checks
items: Group code is identified for this record
Room types matches the current request or source
Cutoff is ready for point-of-use staff
Pickup pace limits or questions are resolved
Attrition review is communicated to the responsible person
Housing handoff is confirmed at handoff
A changed room block fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Room Block failed or pending items

sections.title: Room Block readiness
sections.guidance: Hold room block readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Room Block reviewer receipt

fields.label: Service lead or responsible manager and date

blocks.guidance: Room Block receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
